people.name: Anath
people.line: Father of Shamgar, a judge of Israel

people.name: Jael
people.line: Wife of Heber; killed Sisera, the Canaanite commander.

people.name: Shamgar
people.line: Judge of Israel who killed 600 Philistines

translations.web: “In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked through byways.
translations.bsb: In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were deserted and the travelers took the byways.
translations.kjv: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, and the travellers walked through byways.
translations.asv: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, In the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied, And the travellers walked through byways.
